name: sparx — Day Spa (Nordic)
tagline: A calm, mineral template for day spas and bathhouses — book online from day one.
description: A cool, mineral day spa and bathhouse site — a glacial off-white palette, a blue-teal primary and a clean minimal sans, with quiet, elemental photography. Installs a working booking flow: thermal soak sessions, a sauna and cold-plunge circuit, 60/90-minute massage, a mineral facial and body treatment, plus a private bathhouse hour with a deposit. Three therapists and three pools and rooms carry real hours. Ships as “Kald”.
